Also, perused reply filed  of the State.

On 1.7.2019, present applicants were released  on ad interim anticipatory bail on condition that they shall  cooperate with Investigating Officer and shall be available to  Investigating Officer as and when they are required.
5. Even, according to the prosecution, the  contraband is already seized and present applicants attended  the police station and joined investigation.

6 . During the course of hearing, learned counsel  Shri A.A.Dhawas for applicants, volunteered that applicant  No.1-Bhushan s/o Deoraoji Chikte will deposit Rs.60,000/-
 in the Court of learned Magistrate, Saoner within a period of  two weeks from today.

7. In this view of the matter, I pass following  order:
 ORDER (i) The criminal application is allowed.
(ii) Order passed by this Court on 1.7.2019 is made absolute.
(iii) Applicant No.1-Bhushan s/o Deoraoji Chikte, shall deposit Rs.60,000/- in the Court of learned Magistrate, Saoner within a period of two weeks from today.

(iv) The amount so deposited by applicant No.1-Bhushan s/o Deoraoji Chikte, shall be treated as Muddemal of Crime .....3/-
aba417.19 6 No.134/2019.

(v) Learned Magistrate, Saoner, shall invest the said amount with any Nationalized Bank initially for a period of 3 years and shall renew the said as and when occasion therefor arises.
(vi) None of applicants shall be entitled to file application for withdrawal of the said amount.
(vii) Competent Court, after Trail is over, shall pass appropriate orders for disposal of the Muddemal property.

(viii) Applicant No.1-Bhushan s/o Deoraoji Chikte, is directed to produce receipt before Investigating Officer showing depositing of Rs.60,000/- in the Court of learned Magistrate, Saoner,
on or before 17.9.2019.

(ix) Applicants are also directed to attend the police station as and when they are called by Investigating Officer, however for that Investigating Officer shall give them a 3 days' clear cut written communication.
(x) If receipt is not produce before Investigating Officer on or before the date specified in this order

,
it shall be open for Investigating Officer to file an application for cancellation of the anticipatory bail granted to applicant No.1-Bhushan s/o .....4/-
aba417.19 6 Deoraoji Chikte.
(xi) With this, the criminal application stands disposed of accordingly.
